task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First step, make absolutely sure that the chest drawer is open. If you have pulled open the chest drawer, take the old key from the chest drawer in the bedroom. With the old key, doublecheck that the wooden door within the bedroom is unlocked with the old key. Then, ensure that the wooden door is open. And then, attempt to take a trip east. With that over with, doublecheck that the screen door is ajar. After that, go east. Following that, make an effort to go to the south. And then, pick up the apple from the floor of the garden. If you have taken the apple, go to the north. And then, move west. With that accomplished, place the apple on the stove within the kitchen. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
